prompt.v: Which single move takes triangle ABC to triangle A′B′C′?

problems.explain: Compare a side: AB goes (−11, −2) and A′B′ goes (2, −11), the same length, so the size is kept. A → B → C and A′ → B′ → C′ both run counterclockwise, so it has not been flipped, but the side points a new way: it has turned. So a rotation.
